recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, asymmetrical salon-style gallery wall featuring a mix of framed religious iconography, family portraits, and crucifixes, centered around a vintage wooden double-dial barometer/clock.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking arrangement of varied frame sizes and orientations
Repetition of the crucifix form as vertical anchors between frames
Contrast between sepia-toned religious prints and full-color family snapshots
Central vertical axis created by the wooden barometer
coreInvariants: Eclectic mix of wood, gold, and dark-stained frames
Presence of multiple crucifixes of varying materials (wood, metal, plastic)
Soft, diffused indoor lighting with minimal harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A cluster of approximately 20 items distributed across the central and upper-left visual field, varying from small 3x5 snapshots to medium 11x14 frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A dark wood, double-circle barometer with silver dials positioned slightly right of the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves in a zig-zag pattern following the vertical lines of the crosses and the horizontal alignment of frame edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal space between objects (1-3 inches), with larger negative space at the bottom and right edges of the composition.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and black (frame borders and wooden crosses)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and brass (metallic frames and dial rims)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a warm, aged patina; values are distributed through dark frame accents against a light wall.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat, cream-colored interior wall with a collection of vintage framed items. Include several small to medium wooden and gold frames containing religious icons (Madonna and Child, Sacred Heart) and candid family photos. Intersperse various crucifixes between the frames. Place a dark wood double-dial barometer in the lower-center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: No text overlay required for this composition.

verificationChecks: Ensure frames are not perfectly aligned in a grid
Check that crucifixes are varied in style and material
Verify the barometer has two distinct circular glass dials
Confirm the lighting feels like natural indoor ambient light

adjustableVariables: Ratio of religious icons to family photos
Wall color (e.g., pale blue or sage green)
Frame material dominance (more gold vs. more wood)
mustRedesign: Specific faces in family photos to avoid likeness issues
Any specific trademarked logos on the clock/barometer dials

mustAchieve: A sense of personal history and lived-in devotion
Varied textures between wood, glass, and metal

postGenerationChecks: Are there at least 4 distinct crucifixes?
Is the barometer the most unique object in the cluster?
Do the frames look aged rather than brand new?
Is the wall color a warm neutral?
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a salon-style gallery wall on a [Wall Color] background. Feature a central [Unique Anchor Object] surrounded by an asymmetrical cluster of [Frame Type A] and [Frame Type B] containing [Subject Matter A] and [Subject Matter B]. Intersperse [Small Decorative Object] throughout the gaps to create vertical rhythm.
